fusions.name: Heavy Settle
fusions.desc: Settles all your weight on every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 12 damage and stunning each for 1 second. Each hit has a 60% chance of [Hindered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Verdict
fusions.desc: A crushing blow that deals 32 damage and 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Its damage rises +8% per affliction the target carries (max +40%), resolved 6 seconds later.

fusions.name: Unhurried Recovery
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Accrual
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (56% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
